name: Magebane (Magic Weapon Quality)
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 8th; Price +1 bonus; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

Magebane weapons were developed for fighting wizards and others who use arcane magic. Against enemies capable of casting arcane spells, the weapon’s enhancement bonus is +2 better than its actual bonus. It also deals an extra 2d6 points of damage to them. A creature capable of casting arcane spells takes a -1 penalty to concentration checks when holding a magebane weapon.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Mage Slayer
